dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「それで、あの後の月城さん、どうでした？」
dialogues.en: "How was Tsukishiro-san after that?"
dialogues.text: "How was Tsukishiro-san after that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、余計に｛ふさ／塞｝ぎこんじまったっつーか」
dialogues.en: "She seemed like she needed some time alone."
dialogues.text: "She seemed like she needed some time alone."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、美春が持ってきたバナナクッキー（この
前の残りだそうだ）をボリボリとかじりながら、
そう言った。
dialogues.en:
I munched on the banana cookies (leftovers from the party a
few days ago) Miharu had brought, as I relayed information
to her.
dialogues.text:
I munched on the banana cookies (leftovers from the party a
few days ago) Miharu had brought, as I relayed information
to her.

dialogues.jp:
「つか、お前、すっかり俺んちでくつろいでん
　なぁ。曲がりなりにも男がひとりで住んでる
　家だぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, you sure are reckless, aren't you? Barging in to a
bachelor's pad like this."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, you sure are reckless, aren't you? Barging in to a
bachelor's pad like this."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、朝倉先輩、寂しいと思って。ほら、
　音夢先輩がいなくなって、めっきり静かになっ
　たんじゃないですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Nooo, I just thought Asakura-senpai was feeling lonely.
It's so quiet without Nemu-senpai around, isn't it?"
dialogues.text:
"Nooo, I just thought Asakura-senpai was feeling lonely.
It's so quiet without Nemu-senpai around, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「うるさいのがいなくなって｛せいせい／清々｝してる。ま、
　今は代わりのうるさいヤツが家に来てるみた
　いだけど」
dialogues.en:
"It's refreshing to not have some loud girl around all the
time. Although right now, another loud girl has taken her
place."
dialogues.text:
"It's refreshing to not have some loud girl around all the
time. Although right now, another loud girl has taken her
place."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あーっ、そのうるさいヤツってもしかして、
　美春のことですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh~, you can't mean me by that, can you?"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh~, you can't mean me by that, can you?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「他に誰がいるってんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Who else COULD I mean?"
dialogues.text: "Who else COULD I mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春はうるさくなんかないですよー！　せっ
　かく、遊びに来たっていうのに、その言いぐ
　さはヒドイですよー」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not loud~! That's so mean, saying that after I came
here specially to keep you company!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm not loud~! That's so mean, saying that after I came
here specially to keep you company!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「バナナクッキーだって、わざわざ持ってきて
　あげたのに」
dialogues.en: "I brought all these banana cookies here too!"
dialogues.text: "I brought all these banana cookies here too!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「バナナは栄養があるんですよ？　消化によく
　スタミナに転化しやすい性質を持ってて、な
　おかつ遠足のおやつでは外せない……」
dialogues.en:
"Bananas are very nutritious, don't you know? It gives you
lots of stamina after you digest it, so you can keep running
without..."
dialogues.text:
"Bananas are very nutritious, don't you know? It gives you
lots of stamina after you digest it, so you can keep running
without..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そういうところが、うるさいってんだよ」
dialogues.en: "And look at how right I am."
dialogues.text: "And look at how right I am."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「む〜っ、む〜っ、む〜っ！」
dialogues.en: "Boo, booo, boooo!"
dialogues.text: "Boo, booo, boooo!"

dialogues.jp:
美春はまるで子どものように手足をバタバタと
動かした。
dialogues.en:
She stamped her feet into the ground with her arms crossed,
just like a kid.
dialogues.text:
She stamped her feet into the ground with her arms crossed,
just like a kid.

dialogues.jp:
そして、しばらくしたらゼンマイ式のロボット
のオモチャみたいにおとなしくなった。
dialogues.en:
Moments after, she became docile again, just like a
spring-toy that needed to be wound up again.
dialogues.text:
Moments after, she became docile again, just like a
spring-toy that needed to be wound up again.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……それで、月城さんはそんなに落ち込ん
　じゃってるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...So, Tsukishiro-san's still feeling down?"
dialogues.text: "...So, Tsukishiro-san's still feeling down?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。体育館の裏で育てていた花は、彼女が
　なにか大切な願いをかけていたモノなんだと
　さ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. It seems she carried a huge wish for the plant behind
the gym..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. It seems she carried a huge wish for the plant behind
the gym..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「それで、毎日……一生懸命？」
dialogues.en: "So that's why, she worked so hard to make it grow...?"
dialogues.text: "So that's why, she worked so hard to make it grow...?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そういうこと。でも、この前の嵐で、ダメに
　なったワケ。しかも、それが最後の種だった
　んだそうだ」
dialogues.en:
"Pretty much. That recent storm made it impossible though...
and that was the last seed she had."
dialogues.text:
"Pretty much. That recent storm made it impossible though...
and that was the last seed she had."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、月城さんは願いを叶えることができ
　なくなった……」
dialogues.en: "Meaning her wish will never be granted..."
dialogues.text: "Meaning her wish will never be granted..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そういうことだ。はっきりいって、珍
　しい花だろうが、なんだろうが、願いなんか
　叶えちゃくれないだろうがな」
dialogues.en:
"That's about it. What kind of flower is that, really... a
rare flower that only can grant wishes, supposedly..."
dialogues.text:
"That's about it. What kind of flower is that, really... a
rare flower that only can grant wishes, supposedly..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、夢なさ過ぎですよ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, people have their dreams."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, people have their dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「花が咲いた時に、やっぱり願いは叶わなくっ
　て、その時あらためてガッカリするだけだ」
dialogues.en:
"Even if the flower blooms, there's no guarantee it'd grant
your wish... the disappointment from that would be immense."
dialogues.text:
"Even if the flower blooms, there's no guarantee it'd grant
your wish... the disappointment from that would be immense."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、美春も本当に願いが叶うなんて、思っ
　てないですけどね」
dialogues.en: "I haven't even thought about what I'd wish for."
dialogues.text: "I haven't even thought about what I'd wish for."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ、お前の願いなんか、バナナ１００万
　本欲しい！　とかなんかだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Your wish would be something like "I want 1 million
bananas!", right?"
dialogues.text:
"Your wish would be something like "I want 1 million
bananas!", right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「よくわかりましたね。まああ、いくら美春で
　も１００万本は言い過ぎで、せいぜい１万本
　くらいで充分です」
dialogues.en:
"You understand well! Hmm, 1 million might be a bit too much
even for me, though. I'd settle for ten thousand!"
dialogues.text:
"You understand well! Hmm, 1 million might be a bit too much
even for me, though. I'd settle for ten thousand!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「かわんねぇっつの。だいたいそんな願いなら、
　一生懸命働いて金を儲ければ、叶うだろ」
dialogues.en:
"Same difference. You can make that kind of wish come true
by working your butt off and spending your earnings on it,
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Same difference. You can make that kind of wish come true
by working your butt off and spending your earnings on it,
anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……４０万円くらいですからね。微妙に現実
　的な夢ですね」
dialogues.en:
"...That'd take around 400,000 yen. Not so attainable for me
right now..."
dialogues.text:
"...That'd take around 400,000 yen. Not so attainable for me
right now..."

dialogues.jp: 美春が思わずため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
Miharu sighed with despair, seeing her dreams of bananas
fade away.
dialogues.text:
Miharu sighed with despair, seeing her dreams of bananas
fade away.

dialogues.jp:
今の俺達には、気の遠くなりそうな値段だが、
将来的に可能といえば、可能だ。
dialogues.en:
Right now, it's an unattainable dream, but in the future,
that cost may well be possible to fund.
dialogues.text:
Right now, it's an unattainable dream, but in the future,
that cost may well be possible to fund.

dialogues.jp: ……バナナに４０万円も使いたくないがな。
dialogues.en: ...Although spending 400,000 yen on bananas is crazy.
dialogues.text: ...Although spending 400,000 yen on bananas is crazy.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さんも何か願いがあるなら、美春達に言っ
　てくれればいいのに。もしかしたら、叶えて
　あげられるかもしれないんですよ？」
dialogues.en:
"She should tell us what she wished for... maybe we could
make it come true?"
dialogues.text:
"She should tell us what she wished for... maybe we could
make it come true?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どだい無理な願いとかじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't think it'd be way too much for us to fulfill?"
dialogues.text: "You don't think it'd be way too much for us to fulfill?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「アレですか？　世界征服をしたいとか、空を
　飛べるようになりたいとか、好きな時に手か
　らお菓子が出せるようになりたいとか」
dialogues.en:
"You mean, like, taking over the world, or flying through
the air, or producing wagashis from your hand when you
want?"
dialogues.text:
"You mean, like, taking over the world, or flying through
the air, or producing wagashis from your hand when you
want?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城が、そんなくだらない願いのために、毎
　日健気に花を育てていたと？」
dialogues.en:
"...You think Tsukishiro would grow that plant so
wholeheartedly, to wish for such silly things like that?"
dialogues.text:
"...You think Tsukishiro would grow that plant so
wholeheartedly, to wish for such silly things like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……冗談に決まってるじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "...Of course I'm kidding!"
dialogues.text: "...Of course I'm kidding!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春も好きな時に手からバナナが出せれば、
　嬉しいんですけどねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Although I'd be really happy if I could make a banana
appear in my hand whenever I want."
dialogues.text:
"Although I'd be really happy if I could make a banana
appear in my hand whenever I want."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……あんまりいいもんじゃないぞ」
dialogues.en: "...It's not as good as it sounds."
dialogues.text: "...It's not as good as it sounds."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？」
dialogues.en: "Haaeh?"
dialogues.text: "Haaeh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ。……いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Ah... uh, never mind."
dialogues.text: "Ah... uh, never mind."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、コホンと咳払いをしてごまかす。
dialogues.en: I cleared my throat. Hope she didn't notice...
dialogues.text: I cleared my throat. Hope she didn't notice...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Senpai..."
dialogues.text: "Senpai..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春達は、これ以上月城さんと仲良くなるこ
　とはできないんですかねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"We won't be able to get closer to Tsukishiro-san at this
rate, huh..."
dialogues.text:
"We won't be able to get closer to Tsukishiro-san at this
rate, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことはないさ……。月城だって、きっ
　と俺達と仲良くしたいと思ってるよ」
dialogues.en:
"That's not true... I'm sure she wants to become closer to
us as well."
dialogues.text:
"That's not true... I'm sure she wants to become closer to
us as well."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうですかねぇ」
dialogues.en: "I wonder..."
dialogues.text: "I wonder..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お前が、そんな弱気でどうするよ？　いつも
　の必要以上の元気はどこへいったんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you being so feeble now? What happened to that
overbearing energeticness?"
dialogues.text:
"Why are you being so feeble now? What happened to that
overbearing energeticness?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、美春もたまには落ち込むこともあるっ
　てことで……」
dialogues.en: "Even I get a little depressed sometimes..."
dialogues.text: "Even I get a little depressed sometimes..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……自分言ってりゃ、世話ないな」
dialogues.en: "...Saying it yourself, you'd get no help from me."
dialogues.text: "...Saying it yourself, you'd get no help from me."

dialogues.jp: 俺がそう言うと、美春はエヘヘと笑った。
dialogues.en: Miharu giggled at my straight reply.
dialogues.text: Miharu giggled at my straight reply.

dialogues.jp:
「もしかしたら、些細なきっかけでいいのかも
　しれない」
dialogues.en:
"All we need, is a little chance to break through her
shell."
dialogues.text:
"All we need, is a little chance to break through her
shell."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「心に深い深い傷を負っていたら？」
dialogues.en: "And help heal the deep, deep wound in her heart?"
dialogues.text: "And help heal the deep, deep wound in her heart?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「傷なら、治せんこともないだろ。時間はかか
　るかもしれないがな」
dialogues.en:
"No matter how deep it is, it can always be healed. It might
just take time."
dialogues.text:
"No matter how deep it is, it can always be healed. It might
just take time."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そうですよね。なら、いつか美春達は
　仲良くなれるってことですよね」
dialogues.en: "I guess so. Someday, we'd all be good friends for sure."
dialogues.text: "I guess so. Someday, we'd all be good friends for sure."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。俺はそう思ってる」
dialogues.en: "Yep, that's what I think."
dialogues.text: "Yep, that's what I think."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、美春のバナナクッキーを、指でピンと弾
いて口に放り込んだ。
dialogues.en: I threw another of the banana cookies into my mouth.
dialogues.text: I threw another of the banana cookies into my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ！　今から月城さんちに遊びに行きま
　しょうよ。春休みで退屈してますよ、きっと」
dialogues.en:
"Okay then! Let's go to Tsukishiro-san's place! I'm sure
she's bored, during this spring vacation!"
dialogues.text:
"Okay then! Let's go to Tsukishiro-san's place! I'm sure
she's bored, during this spring vacation!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「い、今から？」
dialogues.en: "N, now?"
dialogues.text: "N, now?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうですよ？　まだ２時じゃないですか。別
　に変でもないし、ご迷惑な時間じゃないと思
　いますけど」
dialogues.en:
"Why not? It's not even 2 PM yet. It's not an odd time to
visit, and I don't think we'd be bothers there."
dialogues.text:
"Why not? It's not even 2 PM yet. It's not an odd time to
visit, and I don't think we'd be bothers there."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、『よしっ』と握り拳を作りながら、ソ
ファから立ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
With a clenched fist and a war cry, Miharu leapt up from the
sofa.
dialogues.text:
With a clenched fist and a war cry, Miharu leapt up from the
sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「行きますよ、先輩」
dialogues.en: "Let's go, senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go, senpai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、かったるいなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Pah, troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "Pah, troublesome..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春に、先輩の｛・・・・・／かったるい｝は効きませんよ。
　美春はなんでもお見通しなんですから！」
dialogues.en:
"Too bad, your "troublesome" doesn't have any effect on me.
I saw it way in advance, after all!"
dialogues.text:
"Too bad, your "troublesome" doesn't have any effect on me.
I saw it way in advance, after all!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、美春に腕を掴まれ、引きずられるように
して外に連れ出されるのだった。
dialogues.en:
Sighing, I grabbed Miharu's hand, and dragged her out and
towards Tsukishiro's place.
dialogues.text:
Sighing, I grabbed Miharu's hand, and dragged her out and
towards Tsukishiro's place.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「これは、朝倉様、天枷様。ようこそいらっしゃ
　いました。──おや、杉並様は？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, this would be Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama. Welcome.
--Oh, where might Suginami-sama be?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, this would be Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama. Welcome.
--Oh, where might Suginami-sama be?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「……あいつは、遠い世界へ旅に出ています」
dialogues.en: "...He's travelling to some faraway land."
dialogues.text: "...He's travelling to some faraway land."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「旅、ですか」
dialogues.en: "Travelling, you say?"
dialogues.text: "Travelling, you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……あはは」
dialogues.en: "...Ahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "...Ahahaha..."

dialogues.jp: 美春が苦笑する。
dialogues.en: Miharu laughed embarassedly at my sarcasm.
dialogues.text: Miharu laughed embarassedly at my sarcasm.

dialogues.speaker: Postman
dialogues.jp: 「──郵便でーす」
dialogues.en: "--Mail delivering!"
dialogues.text: "--Mail delivering!"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「おや、失礼」
dialogues.en: "Ah, please excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Ah, please excuse me."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんが、席を外し、しばらくして、戻って
くる。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san left his seat, and came back shortly.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san left his seat, and came back shortly.

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、開封した手紙の中身を見ながら、
フムフムと頷いていた。
dialogues.en:
He opened the envelope, and read the contents, nodding and
making "hmm" sounds.
dialogues.text:
He opened the envelope, and read the contents, nodding and
making "hmm" sounds.

dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんですか？　妙に頷いちゃったりし
　て……」
dialogues.en:
"Is something wrong? That letter seems to be,
interesting..."
dialogues.text:
"Is something wrong? That letter seems to be,
interesting..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、とてもいいタイミングだなと思いまし
　て」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I was just pondering the coincidental timing of it
all."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I was just pondering the coincidental timing of it
all."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.en: "Hah?"
dialogues.text: "Hah?"

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんは、何枚かの写真を差し出した。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san handed us several photos that came with the
envelope.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san handed us several photos that came with the
envelope.

dialogues.jp: そこには……。
dialogues.en: They showed...
dialogues.text: They showed...

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「確かに、杉並様はご旅行に行かれているよう
　ですなぁ。お｛うらや／羨｝ましゅうございます」
dialogues.en:
"It seems Suginami-sama has been travelling indeed. I am
quite envious of him."
dialogues.text:
"It seems Suginami-sama has been travelling indeed. I am
quite envious of him."

dialogues.jp:
そこには、イギリスのメインストリートで、
フィッシュ＆チップスを食べている杉並の姿
があった。
dialogues.en:
The picture was of Suginami standing in a main street in
England, eating fish and chips.
dialogues.text:
The picture was of Suginami standing in a main street in
England, eating fish and chips.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつ、どこ行ってんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Where did he go at this time..."
dialogues.text: "Where did he go at this time..."

dialogues.jp:
どうせ、合成かなんかだろうと、蔑んだ視線を
写真に向ける。
dialogues.en:
That irritating grin raked within me, as I glared at his
picture.
dialogues.text:
That irritating grin raked within me, as I glared at his
picture.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「明日、初音島に帰るとのことです」
dialogues.en: "He will return to Hatsunejima tomorrow, it appears."
dialogues.text: "He will return to Hatsunejima tomorrow, it appears."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「相変わらずよくわからない人ですね……、杉
　並先輩は」
dialogues.en:
"Completely incomprehensible as usual, that
Suginami-senpai..."
dialogues.text:
"Completely incomprehensible as usual, that
Suginami-senpai..."

dialogues.jp:
果たして、そんな言葉で片づけていいものかど
うか迷ったが、考えるだけ無駄なのだと、それ
で終わらせることにした。
dialogues.en:
That statement was as true as could be. It's useless to
think about it, so that'd be the end of that.
dialogues.text:
That statement was as true as could be. It's useless to
think about it, so that'd be the end of that.

dialogues.jp: 「それで、月城は……？」
dialogues.en: "Um, where's Tsukishiro...?"
dialogues.text: "Um, where's Tsukishiro...?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「残念ながら、お嬢様は本日はお出かけになっ
　ていらっしゃいます。レコードでも買いに行
　かれたのではと思いますが」
dialogues.en:
"Unfortunately, the mistress has went shopping today. I
believe she intends to purchase more records."
dialogues.text:
"Unfortunately, the mistress has went shopping today. I
believe she intends to purchase more records."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……そうですか」
dialogues.en: "Ah... I see."
dialogues.text: "Ah... I see."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いないんじゃあ、なぁ、美春」
dialogues.en: "She's not here, huh, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "She's not here, huh, Miharu."

dialogues.jp: 美春が、ちょっぴり寂しそうに頷く。
dialogues.en: Miharu lonesomely nodded.
dialogues.text: Miharu lonesomely nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「おふたりがいらしたことは、お嬢様にお伝え
　しておきますので……。またどうぞ、いらし
　てください」
dialogues.en:
"I will inform the mistress that the both of you came to
visit her... please come back any time you wish."
dialogues.text:
"I will inform the mistress that the both of you came to
visit her... please come back any time you wish."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.en: "Ah... okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah... okay."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「残念ですが、美春は帰ることにします」
dialogues.en: "I guess I should be heading back too."
dialogues.text: "I guess I should be heading back too."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　帰るのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? You too?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? You too?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩のウチにあまり遅くまでいても、ご迷惑
　ですし」
dialogues.en:
"Your house is kinda far away from here, and I'd only be
more trouble, so..."
dialogues.text:
"Your house is kinda far away from here, and I'd only be
more trouble, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「何を、今さら……」
dialogues.en: "Huh? You're..."
dialogues.text: "Huh? You're..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「というのは、冗談で」
dialogues.en: "Kidding, of course!"
dialogues.text: "Kidding, of course!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……冗談カヨ」
dialogues.en: "...Damn."
dialogues.text: "...Damn."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「実は、今日はお夕飯を外に食べに行くから早
　く帰ってこいと言われておりまして」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, I'm going out to eat for dinner tonight, so I
need to head back early to prepare."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, I'm going out to eat for dinner tonight, so I
need to head back early to prepare."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「外食かぁ」
dialogues.en: "Eating out, huh."
dialogues.text: "Eating out, huh."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩も来ますか？　たぶん、うちの親は何も
　言わないと思いますよ。むしろ歓迎すると思
　いますが」
dialogues.en:
"Do you want to come too, senpai? I think my parents
wouldn't mind; they'd welcome you, in fact!"
dialogues.text:
"Do you want to come too, senpai? I think my parents
wouldn't mind; they'd welcome you, in fact!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、そういうのはさすがにかったるい」
dialogues.en: "...No thanks. That really sounds troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...No thanks. That really sounds troublesome."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今の｛・・・・・／かったるい｝は、本気で｛・・・・・／かったるい｝って感
　じですね」
dialogues.en: "That "troublesome" had a serious "troublesome" feel to it."
dialogues.text: "That "troublesome" had a serious "troublesome" feel to it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、その本気ってのは」
dialogues.en: "I'm always serious."
dialogues.text: "I'm always serious."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、先輩。また来週にでも遊びに来ます
　から、これで失礼しまーす」
dialogues.en:
"See you later, senpai! I'd come visit you soemtime next
week, too!"
dialogues.text:
"See you later, senpai! I'd come visit you soemtime next
week, too!"

dialogues.jp:
美春は、ぺこりと頭を下げると、くるりと振り
返りそのままたったか走っていった。
dialogues.en:
Miharu gave me a quick bow, then ran off in the opposite
direction.
dialogues.text:
Miharu gave me a quick bow, then ran off in the opposite
direction.

dialogues.jp: 「たく、春休みくらい友達と遊びに行けっての」
dialogues.en:
"Pah, and I thought spring break was for spending time with
friends."
dialogues.text:
"Pah, and I thought spring break was for spending time with
friends."

dialogues.jp:
さて、月城もいないし、美春も帰ってしまった
し、杉並もイギリスへ行ってるし（これは未だ
に信じがたいが）誰もいなくなってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Let's see... Tsukishiro isn't around, Miharu went home,
Suginami is in England (or so he claims)... that leaves no
one.
dialogues.text:
Let's see... Tsukishiro isn't around, Miharu went home,
Suginami is in England (or so he claims)... that leaves no
one.

dialogues.jp: 「そういや、今日は２９日か」
dialogues.en: "Oh wait, today's the 29th."
dialogues.text: "Oh wait, today's the 29th."

dialogues.jp:
集めてるマンガの最新刊の発売日じゃないか。
早速買いに行かねば。
dialogues.en:
That's the release date for all the newest manga issues. I
better hurry up and check it out.
dialogues.text:
That's the release date for all the newest manga issues. I
better hurry up and check it out.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ポケットの財布の中身を確認すると、商
店街のブック北川に足を向けた。
dialogues.en:
Making sure I had something in my wallet, I entered the
bookshop in the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
Making sure I had something in my wallet, I entered the
bookshop in the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
さすがは最新刊。人気のあるヤツだから、目立
つところに平積みにしてあった。
dialogues.en:
All the popular mangas were stacked up in a mountain of
books, and surrounded by people.
dialogues.text:
All the popular mangas were stacked up in a mountain of
books, and surrounded by people.

dialogues.jp:
俺が本を取った隣にも平積みの山があったっぽ
いから、もう随分と売れちゃったみたいだな。
dialogues.en:
I grabbed one from near the base of the "mountain". At this
rate, they'd all be gone within a few hours.
dialogues.text:
I grabbed one from near the base of the "mountain". At this
rate, they'd all be gone within a few hours.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、買った本を小脇に挟んで、商店街をうろ
つく。
dialogues.en:
With the bought manga snugly under my arm, I continued
wandering around the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
With the bought manga snugly under my arm, I continued
wandering around the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
このままひとりでブラブラするのもいいし、知っ
たヤツに出会えば、そのままどこかに遊びに行
くのもいいし。
dialogues.en:
If I walk around here long enough, maybe I'd bump into
someone I know, and we could do something less boring.
dialogues.text:
If I walk around here long enough, maybe I'd bump into
someone I know, and we could do something less boring.

dialogues.jp:
──と思った矢先に、少し先のベンチに月城が
座っているのが見えた。
dialogues.en:
--And right on cue, Tsukishiro was sitting on a bench I was
talking towards.
dialogues.text:
--And right on cue, Tsukishiro was sitting on a bench I was
talking towards.

dialogues.jp: 「月城。買い物は済んだのか？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro! Done with your shopping?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro! Done with your shopping?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「あ、瀬場さんに聞いたんだ。昼過ぎにさ、美
　春と月城のうち遊びに行ったけど、買い物に
　言ってるって聞いて」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I heard it from Seiba-san. Miharu and I went over in
the afternoon to visit, and heard that you were out
shopping."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I heard it from Seiba-san. Miharu and I went over in
the afternoon to visit, and heard that you were out
shopping."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「一緒に帰らないか？　買い物、終わったんだ
　ろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Shall we head home together? You are done with your
shopping, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Shall we head home together? You are done with your
shopping, right?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、レコードが入っているらしい紙袋を持っ
て座っていた。
dialogues.en:
Beside Tsukishiro was a paper bag, with what looked like a
record sitting inside.
dialogues.text:
Beside Tsukishiro was a paper bag, with what looked like a
record sitting inside.

dialogues.jp: 月城は、ふるふると首を横に振った。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro shook her head from side to side.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro shook her head from side to side.

dialogues.jp: 「まだ、何か用事があるとか？」
dialogues.en: "You still have things to do?"
dialogues.text: "You still have things to do?"

dialogues.jp: 月城は、浮かない顔で足をさすった。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's eyes wandered over to her foot.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's eyes wandered over to her foot.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...That."
dialogues.text: "...That."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「足、くじいたのか」
dialogues.en: "You hurt your leg?"
dialogues.text: "You hurt your leg?"

dialogues.jp: 月城が、俺の顔を見上げて、こくんと頷く。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro looked back up at my face, and nodded.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro looked back up at my face, and nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「どれくらい痛いんだ？　ひとりで歩けないく
　らいか？」
dialogues.en: "How much does it hurt? You can't walk by yourself?"
dialogues.text: "How much does it hurt? You can't walk by yourself?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、足をさすりながら、時々顔を苦痛に歪
めた。
dialogues.en:
She swung her leg back and forth a bit, with her face
constantly grimacing in pain.
dialogues.text:
She swung her leg back and forth a bit, with her face
constantly grimacing in pain.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと見ていいか？」
dialogues.en: "I'd take a look."
dialogues.text: "I'd take a look."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城の靴を脱がし、ソックスをゆっくり
と脱がす。
dialogues.en: I removed her shoes, and slowly peeled off her socks.
dialogues.text: I removed her shoes, and slowly peeled off her socks.

dialogues.jp: 白く細い足首が少しだけ赤く腫れていた。
dialogues.en: That smooth, white ankle was swollen, slightly red.
dialogues.text: That smooth, white ankle was swollen, slightly red.

dialogues.jp:
「それほどひどくないから、たぶん明日おとな
　しくしてれば、治るんじゃないかな」
dialogues.en:
"If you don't move it around too much, it should heal fully
by tomorrow or so."
dialogues.text:
"If you don't move it around too much, it should heal fully
by tomorrow or so."

dialogues.jp:
「そこのコンビニで、湿布を買ってくるから、
　ちょっと待ってな」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to that convenience store to buy a compress. Wait
a bit, okay?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to that convenience store to buy a compress. Wait
a bit, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、道路を挟んだ向かいにあるコンビニに入
り、湿布と包帯を買ってくる。
dialogues.en:
I entered the convenience store just across the street, and
quickly bought a compress and some bandages."
dialogues.text:
I entered the convenience store just across the street, and
quickly bought a compress and some bandages."

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと痛いかも知れないけど」
dialogues.en: "This might hurt a little."
dialogues.text: "This might hurt a little."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城の足首に湿布をあてる。
dialogues.en: I placed the compress on her ankle.
dialogues.text: I placed the compress on her ankle.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……冷たい」
dialogues.en: "...It's cold."
dialogues.text: "...It's cold."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ちゃんと冷やしてれば、腫れも収まるよ」
dialogues.en: "You have to keep it cool to keep the swelling down."
dialogues.text: "You have to keep it cool to keep the swelling down."

dialogues.jp: 月城がこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro nodded.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「俺に負ぶさって帰ればいいよ。それともカッ
　コ悪くてイヤか？」
dialogues.en:
"It'd be best if I carry you on my back, home... do you mind
that?"
dialogues.text:
"It'd be best if I carry you on my back, home... do you mind
that?"

dialogues.jp: 月城はふるふると首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: She shook her head back and forth, no.
dialogues.text: She shook her head back and forth, no.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「いや、さすがにこんなところに月城を放って
　はおけないからな」
dialogues.en:
"It's okay, there's no way I could've left you here like
this anyway."
dialogues.text:
"It's okay, there's no way I could've left you here like
this anyway."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、コンビニの袋に月城の靴とソックスを詰
め込む。そして、買ったマンガもその中に入れ、
月城に背中を向けてしゃがむ。
dialogues.en:
I threw Tsukishiro's sock and shoe, and the manga I bought,
into the convenience store bag. I then squatted in front of
her.
dialogues.text:
I threw Tsukishiro's sock and shoe, and the manga I bought,
into the convenience store bag. I then squatted in front of
her.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、つかまりな」
dialogues.en: "Here, hold on tight."
dialogues.text: "Here, hold on tight."

dialogues.jp:
こくんと頷いて、月城がゆっくりと俺に身体を
預ける。
dialogues.en: With a nod, she slowly climbed on top of my body.
dialogues.text: With a nod, she slowly climbed on top of my body.

dialogues.jp: 月城の｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な身体が俺の背中に乗っかる。
dialogues.en: I stood up, feeling her delicate body on my back.
dialogues.text: I stood up, feeling her delicate body on my back.

dialogues.jp: 「月城は軽くて助かるよ」
dialogues.en: "It's good that you're really light."
dialogues.text: "It's good that you're really light."

dialogues.jp:
細い腕が背中から首に回る。俺は月城のおしり
に手を回し、しっかり落ちないようにする。
dialogues.en:
Tiny arms were lightly hitting my back. I quickly let my
arms drop to the side; the arms that were formerly holding
her behind.
dialogues.text:
Tiny arms were lightly hitting my back. I quickly let my
arms drop to the side; the arms that were formerly holding
her behind.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ひゃう」

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「あ、その……別に、おしりを触りたくて、
　……だな、じゃなくて、その」
dialogues.en:
"A, ahh... I didn't... mean to touch your behind... not
there..."
dialogues.text:
"A, ahh... I didn't... mean to touch your behind... not
there..."

dialogues.jp:
月城の声を聞いて、とたんに俺はなんだか照れ
くさくなった。
dialogues.en: Hearing her quiet yelps made me extremely embarassed.
dialogues.text: Hearing her quiet yelps made me extremely embarassed.

dialogues.jp:
なんだかしどろもどろになってしまって、一層
言い訳がましく聞こえてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Stumbling back and forth with my words, a soft voice lilted
into my ears.
dialogues.text:
Stumbling back and forth with my words, a soft voice lilted
into my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...Senpai?"

dialogues.jp: 耳元で、月城の声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: Her mouth was at the tip of my ear, whispering.
dialogues.text: Her mouth was at the tip of my ear, whispering.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……さっきは、少し、驚いただけ」
dialogues.en: "...That was just... a bit surprisng."
dialogues.text: "...That was just... a bit surprisng."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うん。そう……だよな。まあ、とにかく
　帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah... it was. Let's just head back."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah... it was. Let's just head back."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、車の通らない公園側の道を通って帰るこ
とにした。
dialogues.en:
I took the path through the park, unusable by vehicles, to
go home.
dialogues.text:
I took the path through the park, unusable by vehicles, to
go home.

dialogues.jp: 「足、痛くないか？」
dialogues.en: "Your foot doesn't hurt now?"
dialogues.text: "Your foot doesn't hurt now?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「レコード何買ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of record did you buy?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of record did you buy?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ベートーヴェン」
dialogues.en: "...Beethoven."
dialogues.text: "...Beethoven."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「あー、そっちはわかんねーや。ジャジャジャ
　ジャーンしか知らねー」
dialogues.en:
"Ahhh, I don't know him either. All those orchestra music
are foreign to me."
dialogues.text:
"Ahhh, I don't know him either. All those orchestra music
are foreign to me."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「なに？　痛い？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? Does it hurt?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? Does it hurt?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Then?"
dialogues.text: "Then?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、気にするなって。それよか、元気そう
　でよかったよ。足以外はさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, don't worry about it. I'm glad enough to see you
doing better... besides your leg, anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Well, don't worry about it. I'm glad enough to see you
doing better... besides your leg, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、月城は話すのが苦手なのか、返事を
するのも時々｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝しているように見える。
dialogues.en:
She really is weak at talking in the end; her words were
always preceded by a moment of hesistation.
dialogues.text:
She really is weak at talking in the end; her words were
always preceded by a moment of hesistation.

dialogues.jp: あまり、話しかけない方が彼女も気が楽かな。
dialogues.en: She'd probably be more comfortable in a quiet environment...
dialogues.text: She'd probably be more comfortable in a quiet environment...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、しばらく話しかけずに静かに歩くことに
した。
dialogues.en: I decided to stop blabbering, and quietly continued walking.
dialogues.text: I decided to stop blabbering, and quietly continued walking.

dialogues.jp: 公園を抜け、並木道に出る。
dialogues.en: We emerged from the park, and into Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text: We emerged from the park, and into Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.jp:
学校へ行かなくなり随分経つから、なんとなく
懐かしい気がした。
dialogues.en:
Having walked down this path so many times on the way to
school, it felt familiar somehow.
dialogues.text:
Having walked down this path so many times on the way to
school, it felt familiar somehow.

dialogues.jp: なんだか、声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: A voice then called out to me.
dialogues.text: A voice then called out to me.

dialogues.jp: なんて言ってるかはわからない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't tell what it was saying.
dialogues.text: I couldn't tell what it was saying.

dialogues.jp:
聞こえるというより、流れ込んでくるという感
覚だ。
dialogues.en:
More than actually being able to hear it, I could feel it
flowing through me.
dialogues.text:
More than actually being able to hear it, I could feel it
flowing through me.

dialogues.jp: 「月城？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "...Never mind, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "...Never mind, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp:
なんだろう、とくんとくんと身体に流れ込んで
くる。
dialogues.en: What is the thing flowing through my body so rapidly?
dialogues.text: What is the thing flowing through my body so rapidly?

dialogues.jp: 声なのか？
dialogues.en: A voice?
dialogues.text: A voice?

dialogues.jp: 気持ちなのか？
dialogues.en: Feelings?
dialogues.text: Feelings?

dialogues.jp: それよりも、月城なのか？
dialogues.en: More importantly, Tsukishiro's?
dialogues.text: More importantly, Tsukishiro's?

dialogues.jp: ふいに目の前が真っ暗になる。
dialogues.en: My eyes were suddenly enveloped in a sea of black.
dialogues.text: My eyes were suddenly enveloped in a sea of black.

dialogues.jp:
目が見えなくなったというより、闇の中にいる
感覚。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't see a thing, but I could feel something deep
within the darkness.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't see a thing, but I could feel something deep
within the darkness.

dialogues.jp: さっきから聞こえてきた、あの声だ。
dialogues.en: It was the voice I heard from before.
dialogues.text: It was the voice I heard from before.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「違う、違うよ。私が欲しいのはお人形じゃな
　いよ」
dialogues.en: "No, no! What I wanted wasn't this dumb doll!"
dialogues.text: "No, no! What I wanted wasn't this dumb doll!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「私が欲しいのは、お友達なのに」
dialogues.en: "I want to have friends! To make friends!"
dialogues.text: "I want to have friends! To make friends!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「嫌い、嫌い、お父さんも、お母さんも嫌い！」
dialogues.en: "I hate you, hate you! I hate father, I hate mother!"
dialogues.text: "I hate you, hate you! I hate father, I hate mother!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「サーカスも嫌い！　みんな嫌い！」
dialogues.en: "I hate the circus! I hate everyone!"
dialogues.text: "I hate the circus! I hate everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ピロスは何にも言わないよ。お話ししてくれ
　ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Piros can't say anything, he can't talk to me about
anything!"
dialogues.text:
"Piros can't say anything, he can't talk to me about
anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「お母さん、お父さん、一緒に遊んで、本を読
　んで。サーカスなんて、しなくていいから」
dialogues.en:
"I want mother and father to play with me, to read books to
me! I don't want them to go to the circus!"
dialogues.text:
"I want mother and father to play with me, to read books to
me! I don't want them to go to the circus!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「遊んでくれないなら、お父さんも、お母さん
　も死んじゃえ！」
dialogues.en: "They don't play with me... mother and father should die!!"
dialogues.text: "They don't play with me... mother and father should die!!"

dialogues.jp: 小さな、女の子の声。
dialogues.en: The voice of a tiny girl.
dialogues.text: The voice of a tiny girl.

dialogues.jp: ずっと泣いているような声。
dialogues.en: A voice that sounded like it's been crying for a long time.
dialogues.text: A voice that sounded like it's been crying for a long time.

dialogues.jp: 誰の声だ？
dialogues.en: Whose voice is this?
dialogues.text: Whose voice is this?

dialogues.jp: 月城の声か？
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's?
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's?

dialogues.jp:
気がつくと、俺は通学路の並木道のところを歩
いていた。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly recovered consciousness, and found myself still
walking on the usual Sakura Avenue to school.
dialogues.text:
I suddenly recovered consciousness, and found myself still
walking on the usual Sakura Avenue to school.

dialogues.en: "--Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "--Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、俺の背中で、すーすーと寝息を立てて
いた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was sleeping, her rhythmic breathing almost
hypnotic.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was sleeping, her rhythmic breathing almost
hypnotic.

dialogues.jp: 今のはやはり、月城の声なのだろうか……。
dialogues.en: That must've been Tsukishiro's voice just now...
dialogues.text: That must've been Tsukishiro's voice just now...

dialogues.jp: 過去の記憶……。
dialogues.en: The memories of her past...
dialogues.text: The memories of her past...

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが言っていたことが思い浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san's words came flooding back into my head.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san's words came flooding back into my head.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「物言わぬ人形ではお嬢様の心を癒すことがで
　きなかったようです」
dialogues.en:
"A doll, which could not even speak, was not enough to heal
the mistress's heart."
dialogues.text:
"A doll, which could not even speak, was not enough to heal
the mistress's heart."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様は、ついにご両親にご不満をぶつけら
　れたそうです」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress, in the end, became filled with anger at her
parents, and threw a temper tantrum at them."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress, in the end, became filled with anger at her
parents, and threw a temper tantrum at them."

dialogues.jp: サーカスなんかやってなければと……。
dialogues.en: In the end, the circus was never meant for her...
dialogues.text: In the end, the circus was never meant for her...

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「後日享司様とソフィ様は、公演中事故に遭わ
　れ、お亡くなりになられたのです」
dialogues.en:
"Kyouji-sama and Sophie-sama were distracted by the
mistress's harshness, and during a performance, met with a
terrible accident. They did not survive."
dialogues.text:
"Kyouji-sama and Sophie-sama were distracted by the
mistress's harshness, and during a performance, met with a
terrible accident. They did not survive."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、それを自分のせいだと思っている。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro then thought that it was her fault...
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro then thought that it was her fault...

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「それから、お嬢様はご自分の気持ちや、お考
　えでいらっしゃることを口にすることができ
　なくなったようです」
dialogues.en:
"Since then, the mistress would no longer let her true
feelings be known to others."
dialogues.text:
"Since then, the mistress would no longer let her true
feelings be known to others."

dialogues.jp:
自分の言葉が、両親を殺してしまった。月城は
そう思っているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Killing her parents, with her own words. That was what she
thought she had done.
dialogues.text:
Killing her parents, with her own words. That was what she
thought she had done.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「おそらく、口を開くとその時の恐怖を思い出
　されてしまうのでしょう」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps whenever the mistress opens her mouth, the memories
of that incident flood back."
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps whenever the mistress opens her mouth, the memories
of that incident flood back."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「自分の言葉が誰かを傷つけてしまうのではな
　いか、お嬢様はそれを怖がっていらっしゃる
　のではないでしょうか」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress appears to be deathly afraid of ever hurting
anyone else with her own words again."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress appears to be deathly afraid of ever hurting
anyone else with her own words again."

dialogues.jp:
月城が何を言ったって、俺や美春は何も気にし
ないのになぁ。
dialogues.en:
No matter what she could say to us, Miharu and I wouldn't
take it badly at all...
dialogues.text:
No matter what she could say to us, Miharu and I wouldn't
take it badly at all...

dialogues.jp:
月城の両親だって、こんな月城は望んでいない
だろう。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's parents couldn't have wanted her to become this
way.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's parents couldn't have wanted her to become this
way.

dialogues.jp:
彼らが亡くなった原因が、果たして本当に月城
にあったかどうかはわからない。
dialogues.en:
It's not definite that it's Tsukishiro's fault that they met
with the accident, after all.
dialogues.text:
It's not definite that it's Tsukishiro's fault that they met
with the accident, after all.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、自分達の死がたったひとりの娘を悲し
ませてるとしたら、死んでも死にきれないだろ
うなぁ。
dialogues.en:
But I'm sure they wouldn't have wanted to die, and leave
their only daughter so distressed, either.
dialogues.text:
But I'm sure they wouldn't have wanted to die, and leave
their only daughter so distressed, either.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ふと、音夢のことを思い出す。
dialogues.en: My mind turned to Nemu.
dialogues.text: My mind turned to Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
あいつも本当の両親はいない。けれど、今では、
立派に自分の夢を叶えるために頑張っている。
dialogues.en:
Her real parents are no longer with us as well. Yet now,
she's living her life, and working hard to make her dreams
come true.
dialogues.text:
Her real parents are no longer with us as well. Yet now,
she's living her life, and working hard to make her dreams
come true.

dialogues.jp:
自分で言うのは、なんだか照れくさいが、俺や
俺の両親がいたから、だと思う。
dialogues.en:
She said after all, that she still had me and my parents,
which left me a little embarassed.
dialogues.text:
She said after all, that she still had me and my parents,
which left me a little embarassed.

dialogues.jp: 月城も気づいてくれればいいのに。
dialogues.en: I want Tsukishiro to notice that too.
dialogues.text: I want Tsukishiro to notice that too.

dialogues.jp: 美春や、杉並や……俺がいることを。
dialogues.en: That Miharu, Suginami... and I, are all here.
dialogues.text: That Miharu, Suginami... and I, are all here.

dialogues.jp: 俺達が、どれだけ月城のことを慕っているのか。
dialogues.en:
We're always worrying about her, wanting to get closer to
her.
dialogues.text:
We're always worrying about her, wanting to get closer to
her.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら、月城も気づいているのかもしれ
ない。
dialogues.en: Maybe she noticed that already...
dialogues.text: Maybe she noticed that already...

dialogues.jp: ただ、どうしても口から言葉が出ない。
dialogues.en: But, she just couldn't get the words out of her mouth.
dialogues.text: But, she just couldn't get the words out of her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
だから人形に思いを伝えてもらっていたのかも
しれない。
dialogues.en:
So perhaps, that's why she got a doll to communicate to
others for her.
dialogues.text:
So perhaps, that's why she got a doll to communicate to
others for her.

dialogues.jp: たったひとりの友達に。
dialogues.en: Her only friend.
dialogues.text: Her only friend.

dialogues.jp: さっき、俺に気持ちを伝えたようにして。
dialogues.en: I wanted to tell her all the feelings I had just now.
dialogues.text: I wanted to tell her all the feelings I had just now.

dialogues.jp: 「月城……。お前はひとりじゃないんだぞ」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro... you're not alone."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro... you're not alone."

dialogues.jp:
けれど、月城は俺の背中で、心地よさそうに寝
息を立てていた。
dialogues.en:
But all I got in reply, was the steady breathing of the
sleeping Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
But all I got in reply, was the steady breathing of the
sleeping Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp: ◆一人じゃない◆
dialogues.en: ◆You're Not Alone◆
dialogues.text: ◆You're Not Alone◆

dialogues.jp:
あれから、美春も月城のことが随分と心配だっ
たようだ。
dialogues.en: Apparently, Miharu was very worried about Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: Apparently, Miharu was very worried about Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
月城と友達になりたいと思っている美春にとっ
て、月城が元気がないことは、やはりつらいら
しい。
dialogues.en:
To Miharu, so desperate to become Tsukishiro's friend,
hearing that she was still depressed must've been painful
for her.
dialogues.text:
To Miharu, so desperate to become Tsukishiro's friend,
hearing that she was still depressed must've been painful
for her.

dialogues.jp:
俺と美春は、月城の心を癒してやれないものか
と月城邸を訪れるが、残念ながら、月城は外出
中で、会うことはできなかった。
dialogues.en:
We went to Tsukishiro's house to try and get closer to her,
but unfortunately, she went out, and we couldn't see her.
dialogues.text:
We went to Tsukishiro's house to try and get closer to her,
but unfortunately, she went out, and we couldn't see her.

dialogues.jp:
仕方なく、そこで別れた俺と美春。俺の方は商
店街の方に向かった。
dialogues.en:
Having done the best we can, Miharu and I seperated. I ended
up going to the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
Having done the best we can, Miharu and I seperated. I ended
up going to the shopping district.

dialogues.jp:
商店街では、買い物帰りの月城がいて、彼女は
どうやら足をくじいた様子だった。
dialogues.en:
There, I met Tsukishiro, who was heading back from her
shopping. She apparently injured her leg.
dialogues.text:
There, I met Tsukishiro, who was heading back from her
shopping. She apparently injured her leg.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城を負ぶって帰ることにした。
dialogues.en: I carried her on my back, all the way home.
dialogues.text: I carried her on my back, all the way home.

dialogues.jp:
途中、眠ってしまった月城から、彼女の過去の
記憶や寂しい気持ちが、まるで俺に流れ込んで
くるように伝わってきた。
dialogues.en:
On the way, the sleeping Tsukishiro's memories of the past,
and feelings of loneliness, coarsed through my body.
dialogues.text:
On the way, the sleeping Tsukishiro's memories of the past,
and feelings of loneliness, coarsed through my body.

dialogues.jp:
月城、お前はひとりじゃない。俺だって美春だっ
て、杉並だっている。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, you're not alone. Miharu, myself, and even
Suginami are all ehre.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, you're not alone. Miharu, myself, and even
Suginami are all ehre.

dialogues.jp: 寝息を立てる月城に向けて、そう｛ささや／囁｝いた。
dialogues.en: I whispered that to the sleeping Tsukishiro, on my back.
dialogues.text: I whispered that to the sleeping Tsukishiro, on my back.
